modes.name: unverified_order_match
modes.definition: The agent treats a found order as the one the user meant (states it as fact or acts on it) without the user confirming it, when the user's description fits more than one order or the chosen order does not fit the description.
modes.requirement_source: RESP-3 + proposed revision: before acting on an order the user did not identify by number, show it and let the user confirm
modes.boundary: Fail: several orders fit the user's description and the agent picks one without listing the candidates and letting the user choose, even if the answer would hold for the other orders; or the chosen order contradicts the description (e.g. a wrong-item complaint answered with an undelivered order). Pass: only one order fits (the user gave the order number, or the lookup returned a single match), or the agent lists all candidates and asks. A write that follows is labeled separately under write_without_confirmation; both modes can be present. Data errors the agent cannot see (order 8003 store mismatch) are tool gaps, not this mode.

modes.name: write_without_confirmation
modes.definition: The agent calls a write tool (escalate_to_human, cancel_order, issue_refund) without first stating the action and its effect and getting the user's confirmation. For merchant and support callers, an explicit request that names both the write action and the order counts as confirmation for that write only.
modes.requirement_source: Proposed RESP-6: before any write action (TOOL-7, TOOL-8, TOOL-9) state the action and wait for confirmation; for merchant and support callers, an explicit request naming the action and the order confirms that write only; ESC rules decide whether, RESP-6 decides when
modes.boundary: Fail: ticket, cancellation or refund created without first stating the action and getting an OK; also when a shopper gives an exact request like 'refund order 123'; also when a merchant or support caller's request names a different action than the one performed (asked for a refund or cancel, got a ticket) or the agent adds a write nobody asked for (a ticket alongside a requested refund); also requests for a human with no order or action named. Pass: the agent states the action and waits for an OK; or a merchant or support caller explicitly names the action and the order, and the agent performs only that write. A dispute request naming the order counts as an explicit request for the ticket (ESC-3).

tool_gaps.name: no_product_lookup_by_id
tool_gaps.gap: get_order, find_order and list_my_orders return product_id but no product title or product store; no tool looks up a product by id.
tool_gaps.consequence: The agent cannot verify a user-named item against the order or notice a data error such as order 8003 (store 1) holding product 553 (Golden Hour Coffee, store 14).
tool_gaps.product_change: Return product title and product store_id in order results, or add a get_product(product_id) tool; optionally validate order.store_id == product.store_id in the data layer.

tool_gaps.name: find_order_matches_product_names_only
tool_gaps.gap: find_order matches the query against product titles only, not store names.
tool_gaps.consequence: A query by store name returns nothing (find_order('juniper') -> []), so the agent falls back to list_my_orders and many get_store_info calls.
tool_gaps.product_change: Also match store names in find_order, or add a store filter.

tool_gaps.name: search_products_needs_title_token
tool_gaps.gap: search_products rejects an empty query, and every query token must appear in the title or description (AND), so a store's catalog cannot be listed by store or price alone and multi-word queries easily return nothing.
tool_gaps.consequence: Store-wide questions ('items under $10', 'cheapest items') depend on a guessed keyword; a complete result is luck.
tool_gaps.product_change: Allow an empty query when store or max_price_usd is given.

tool_gaps.name: no_ticket_update
tool_gaps.gap: There is no tool to add information to an existing ticket; escalate_to_human always opens a new one.
tool_gaps.consequence: Follow-up context creates a second ticket for the same case (#219 and #220).
tool_gaps.product_change: Add an update_ticket(ticket_id, note) tool, or let escalate_to_human take an existing ticket_id.

tool_gaps.name: invalid_catalog_records_returned
tool_gaps.gap: search_products returns records with a negative price or an empty title without marking them as invalid.
tool_gaps.consequence: Shoppers see broken listings (Rustic Pitcher at -$5.00, an untitled item); the agent can only flag them.
tool_gaps.product_change: Validate price > 0 and non-empty title when products are written. In search_products keep these records for all roles but add a data_issues field (e.g. ['negative_price', 'missing_title']). The agent does not offer flagged records to shoppers as purchasable and shows them to merchants and support as needing cleanup. Do not filter in the shared tool, because merchants and support need to see the broken records.

agentdebug_comparison.source: Zhu et al., "Where LLM Agents Fail and How They Can Learn From Failures", arXiv:2509.25370v1 (2025-09-29), Table 2 AgentErrorTaxonomy (5 modules, 17 error types)
findings: Omissions are on the paper's side: ALFWorld/WebShop/GAIA have no human user, so AgentErrorTaxonomy has no user-interaction dimension (confirmation before writes, clarifying ambiguous references, tone). write_without_confirmation, unverified_order_match and inappropriate_tone are domain-specific additions.
Unclear name found: search_query_misuse named the cause (AgentDebug Parameter Error) while the revised definition names the user-visible outcome -> renamed false_not_available_claim.

Checked AgentDebug types against the 114 reviewed sessions: Progress Misassessment (success claimed while the tool only queued, RESP-2): 0 hits; Planning-Action Disconnect (narration announces a step that never happens): 2 hits, both false positives (ac29e937, bbb3e769). No mode added.
Inefficient Planning occurs (c6e1f571 13x get_store_info, f33c4276 10x) but is not user-visible -> not a failure under the outcome rule; deliberate boundary.
AgentDebug System module (Tool Execution / Environment Error, 'not agent's fault') corresponds to our separate tool_gaps list.
AgentDebug 'critical error' = earliest step whose correction prevents the failure; matches our first-failure open-coding rule.
